abstract: The potential of the soluble forms of the adhesion molecules ICAM-1 (sICAM-1), CD44std (sCD44std) and E-cadherin (sE-cadherin) was tested for the diagnosis of benign and malignant cystic epithelial tumours of the ovary. Concentrations of sICAM-1, sCD44 std and sE-cadherin were measured by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) in the serum and cyst fluid obtained from 23 patients with luteal cysts, 29 with cystadenomas, nine with dermoid cysts, five with borderline tumours and 11 with carcinomas. Serum concentrations of sICAM-1, but not of sCD44std and sE-cadherin, were constantly elevated compared with normal controls. Cyst fluid concentrations of sICAM-1, sCD44std and sE-cadherin were elevated in borderline and malignant tumours compared with cystadenomas (P = 0.034, 0.006 and 0.001, respectively). In conclusion, our results suggest that serum concentrations of adhesion molecules have no diagnostic value in ovarian tumours, whereas cyst fluid concentrations may facilitate distinction between benign lesions and borderline or malignant tumours.
abstract_ja: 卵巣の嚢胞性腫瘍(良性・悪性)の診断について、可溶性接着分子であるICAM-1(sICAM-1)、CD44std(sCD44std)、E-カドヘリン(sE-カドヘリン)の有用性を検討した。黄体嚢胞23例、嚢胞腺腫29例、類皮嚢腫9例、境界悪性腫瘍5例、癌腫11例の患者から採取した血清と嚢胞液について、ELISA法によりこれらの濃度を測定した。血清sICAM-1濃度は正常対照と比べて一貫して上昇していたが、sCD44stdとsE-カドヘリンは上昇していなかった。嚢胞液中のsICAM-1、sCD44std、sE-カドヘリン濃度は、境界悪性腫瘍および悪性腫瘍で嚢胞腺腫より有意に高かった(それぞれP=0.034、0.006、0.001)。以上より、血清中の接着分子濃度は卵巣腫瘍の診断に有用ではないが、嚢胞液中の濃度は良性病変と境界悪性または悪性腫瘍の鑑別に役立つ可能性が示唆された。
